newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG AVOID ANELKA REPEAT WITH DEFENDER DOMI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG AVOID ANELKA REPEAT WITH DEFENDER DOMI.

text.p: Paris St Germain, who let teenage prodigy Nicolas Anelka slip the net and sign for England's Arsenal, have agreed a first professional contract with 18-year-old defender Didier Domi, a first team regular since December.
Domi, like Anelka a product of PSG's youth policy, confirmed on Tuesday he had signed a four-year contract effective from next July.
He has played at left back in PSG's five league games since their 0-0 draw at Nantes in mid-December.

PSG looked set to agree a first professional deal -- their right under French federation rules favouring apprentice players' first club -- with Anelka last month when he promptly announced he would play for London club Arsenal next season.

Nantes have also signed a first professional contract with teenage goalkeeper Mickael Landreau, who has yet to finish on the losing side in 17 consecutive matches since his first division debut in October.
